caveats.en: Elgato lists Video Capture (and its device) as 'does not work' on Windows on Arm; Prism cannot emulate its DirectShow driver. No Arm version is announced.
caveats.zh-TW: Elgato 將 Video Capture（及其擷取裝置）列為在 Windows on Arm 上「無法使用」；Prism 無法模擬它的 DirectShow 驅動程式。尚未宣布 Arm 版。
